name: Zenithal-Tombolo
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a tidally locked hemisphere, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
